description: List the products endoflife.date tracks under one tag, usually a vendor (microsoft, amazon, google, oracle, red-hat), a family (linux-distribution) or a runtime (php-runtime, javascript-runtime). Answers "which Microsoft products have end-of-life dates" before you look up each one. Source: endoflife.date; tags are the project's own grouping (see eol_tags) and a vendor's list may be incomplete. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, products to return, 1-100, default 25

offset.description: integer, optional, skip this many products for paging, default 0

tag.description: string, required, endoflife.date tag (e.g. microsoft, amazon, linux-distribution); see eol_tags

name: eol_products_by_vendor_tag
